impl Strip {
    fn drain(&mut self) {
        for lane in 0..self.controls.len() {
            let available = self.controls[lane].available_at_entry();
            for _ in 0..available {
                let Ok(record) = self.controls[lane].try_pop() else {
                    break;
                };
                apply(record);
            }
        }
    }
}
